description: This file exports several constants and modules related to KaTeX parsing and rendering, including error handling classes, font metric data, and shape definitions for rendering mathematical symbols and structures.

classes.name: a
classes.description: Represents a range within a lexer input, providing a static method to create range instances based on node locations.

classes.name: n
classes.description: Represents a text span with location info, supporting range calculations.

classes.name: i
classes.description: Represents a parsing error with detailed message, position, and location info.

classes.name: v
classes.description: Configuration object class for KaTeX settings, including error handling and rendering options.

classes.name: x
classes.description: Represents a mathematical style or size, with methods for super/sub scripts and fractions.

classes.name: R
classes.description: A class representing LaTeX or MathML nodes, supporting transformation to DOM nodes or markup strings.

methods.name: a.range
methods.description: Creates a range object for an element within the source input based on its location.

methods.name: n.range
methods.description: Returns a new text span with a specified location and source text.

methods.name: i.prototype.__proto__
methods.description: Error object prototype extension for custom parsing errors.
